title: AutoSwarm: coordination across existing agents

claims.text: The README describes routing work by agent capability, sharing context, connecting tools, coordinating parallel tasks and combining results.
Listed integrations include Codex and Claude Code. The host needs skill support and local command execution; collaborators require compatible local CLIs.
Its documentation distinguishes executable/version discovery from probes that test model replies and native resume. Those probes consume model calls.

limitations: Integration and reliability claims are from the project maintainers.
No downloaded instructions were executed and no agent integrations were installed or tested.
gaps: Comparative performance and real-workload reliability remain unverified.
